result.topic_en: Euler introduces a new variable t so that a surface z(x,y) can be compared with all neighbouring surfaces, giving z a third kind of increment dt(dz/dt), and then begins to consider the variation of an arbitrary function V(x,y,z).
result.transcription:
VARIATINVM TRACTANDI. 45
hoc vero ex variatione ipſius $y$ oriundum iſta:
$dy\left(\frac{dz}{dy}\right)$
indicari ſolet.
18. Quodſi iam haec ſuperficies aequatione inter $x$, $y$ et $z$ expreſſa, cum aliis quibuscunque ſuperficiebus ipſi proximis comparari debeat, id commodiſſime fiet nouam variabilem $t$ introducendo, ita vt iam $z$ ſpectanda ſit vt functio trium variabilium, $x$, $y$ et $t$, quae quidem ſumto $t=0$, in functionem ſuperiorem abeant, at dum ipſi $t$ valores infinite parui tribuuntur, omnes ſuperficies proximas complectatur, quo poſito perſpicuum eſt, quoniam variabiles $x$ et $y$ a noua $t$, neutiquam pendent earum differentialia $dx$ et $dy$ nullo modo cum $dt$ permiſceri, ſola vero coordinata $z$ triplicis generis incrementa capere poteſt, praeter bina enim iam ante commemorata, quae vel ab $x$ vel ab $y$ profiſiſcuntur, accipere poterit incrementum a variabilitate ipſius $t$ oriundum, quod tali formula $dt\left(\frac{dz}{dt}\right)$ eſt repraeſentandum.
19. Ponamus nunc V eſſe expreſſionem vtcunque ex ipſis coordinatis $x$, $y$ et $z$ compoſitam, ſiue per meras operationes algebraicas, ſiue etiam tranſcendentes formatas, quae more ſolito differentiata praebeat:
$dV = L\,dx + M\,dy + N\,dz,$
atque ſi eiusdem incrementum deſideretur a noua variabili $t$ ſola oriundum manifeſtum eſt, ſtatui debere
F 3

items.quote: id commodiſſime fiet nouam variabilem $t$ introducendo, ita vt iam $z$ ſpectanda ſit vt functio trium variabilium, $x$, $y$ et $t$
items.english: this is most conveniently done by introducing a new variable t, so that z is now to be regarded as a function of three variables x, y and t

items.quote: quoniam variabiles $x$ et $y$ a noua $t$, neutiquam pendent earum differentialia $dx$ et $dy$ nullo modo cum $dt$ permiſceri
items.english: since the variables x and y in no way depend on the new t, their differentials dx and dy are in no way mixed with dt

items.quote: atque ſi eiusdem incrementum deſideretur a noua variabili $t$ ſola oriundum
items.english: and if the increment of the same (V) arising from the new variable t alone is desired
